name: EMWO World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Chased through a summer-long tournament but never awarded before the federation closed.
notes: Established in the federation's own outline document as its top singles title, defended at least once a month. A tournament to crown the first champion ran across the federation's own July supercard (Christian York advancing past Destroyer by run-in) toward a scheduled final against Jack Vars at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, Summer Sizzler; no surviving document names a champion crowned.
